name: 4MENS - 20 Years of Musical Comedy
description: Celebrate two decades of laughter and song with this special musical comedy performance, promising an evening of pure entertainment.
longDescription:
Celebrate two decades of 4MENS, the acclaimed musical comedy group, as they mark their 20th anniversary with a special performance. Known for their unique blend of humor and musical talent, 4MENS has captivated audiences with their original songs and comedic sketches, establishing themselves as a significant presence in the Portuguese entertainment scene. This event commemorates their journey and enduring appeal.

Attendees can anticipate an evening filled with original musical numbers and comedic routines, delivered in Portuguese. The performance is designed to entertain a broad audience, offering a celebratory atmosphere within the grand setting of Casa da Música. The venue, renowned for its architectural significance and excellent acoustics, provides an ideal backdrop for this milestone event.

Tickets are required for entry. Casa da Música is conveniently located and accessible via public transport; the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent to the venue. Further details regarding specific ticket availability and pricing will be released closer to the event date.
